assets.description: Food visibly touching shallow hot oil in a frying pan; spatula turns potato; small sizzling bubbles.
assets.generationPrompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: square vocabulary illustration for the English cooking verb FRY. Show a close-up of small potato pieces and a few vegetable pieces visibly cooking by direct contact with a shallow layer of sizzling oil in a frying pan on a lit stovetop. Food contacts the pan and oil, tiny sizzling bubbles around edges, a natural hand holds a spatula turning one potato piece. The frying action is unmistakable, not boiling food in water or grilling on a grate.
